basic_info.description: Well positioned on sought after flat block of Cragmont Avenue in Golden Gate Heights, this thoughtfully remodeled Mid-Century home offers a tranquil retreat while it is easily accessible to urban hubs of the Inner Sunset & West Portal areas. Beautiful aesthetic enhancements with focus on efficiency, the latest in clean energy, high quality and safety are made with the addition of solar energy, (NEM 2.0/owned), Nest system & selection of top of the line kitchen & bath appliances and features. The living space boasts a seamless flow; living room w/corner fireplace & dining area, stunning kitchen leading to a fabulous new Timbertech deck and patio. Two bedrooms on are separated by center staircase. Amazing view of Sutro Tower & Twin Peaks, outlooks to lovely tiered garden w/ mature trees, skylights and kitchen glass door. Indoor/outdoor living at its best for a home with abundant natural light! Hardwood floors and smartly finished bath. Legal room and bath on lower level suitable for office, guest or 3rd bedroom. Garage with interior access to foyer. Plenty of extra storage. Central location with JP Murphy & Golden Gate Heights parks nearby, quick access to Golden Gate Park & UCSF and public transportation is just steps away! www.83CragmontAve.com
